group.title: Training before a model change
group.passage:
Man: We're switching Line Three to the compact model tomorrow. Has the new fixture been installed?
Woman: Yes, but the operators haven't practiced loading the smaller housing yet.
Man: Then we should run a short training session before the first shift begins.
Woman: The process engineer is available at seven fifteen. We can use the first five housings for practice.
Man: Please mark those as training pieces so they don't enter finished-goods inventory.
Woman: I'll do that, and I'll place the updated loading instructions beside the fixture.
group.passageZh:
男：我們明天要把三號線換成小型機種。新治具裝好了嗎？
女：好了，但操作員還沒練習過放入較小的外殼。
男：那我們應該在第一班開始前辦一場簡短訓練。
女：製程工程師七點十五分有空。我們可以用前五個外殼來練習。
男：請把那些標示為訓練用品，以免它們進入成品庫存。
女：我會處理，也會把更新的上料說明放在治具旁。
